verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਾ ਫਲੁ ਘਣਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sevaa dhaa fal ghanaa kin keemat hoiee|

en.bdb: Immense is the fruit of the service to the Guru; who can understand its worth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਾਲੈ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)g sura(n)g acharaj hai vekhaalai soiee|

en.bdb: From among the wondrous shades (of life) it makes one see the most wonderful one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੈ ਰਸੁ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: saadh vaddaa visamaadh hai ras gu(n)ge goiee|

en.bdb: The taste of the service is as awesome as the sweet is to the dumb person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਭੁਜ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਸਮੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: autabhuj vaas nivaas hai kar chalat samoiee|

en.bdb: It is a great feat (of God) that the fragrance is there in the trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੋਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਰੈ ਅਜਰੁ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: tol atol amol hai jarai ajar koiee|

en.bdb: The service is invaluable and incomparable; any rare endures this unendurable faculty.
Only God, the omniscient knows the mystery of the service.
